scope: Site evidence and candidate parcel geometry only. This record is not a delineated hydrologic watershed, a survey, a flood-depth determination, an HEC-HMS/HEC-RAS run, or engineering certification. The property parcel, regional HUC boundaries, and the contributing drainage catchment are distinct geometries and must not be substituted for one another.

centroid.method: Centroid coordinates supplied by the IGIO parcel layer

area_estimate.method: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic area calculated from the published outer-ring vertices
area_estimate.limitation: Calculated from statewide parcel GIS geometry; not surveyed legal acreage and not watershed drainage area

parcel.interpretation: This geometry represents the property parcel only. Do not use it as the HMS drainage polygon, the RAS inundation domain, or a surveyed legal boundary.

terrain_sample.method: USGS Elevation Point Query Service result at the parcel-layer centroid, interpolated from the dynamic 3DEP elevation service
terrain_sample.limitation: One point sample only; accuracy depends on source elevation data and it does not replace a site DEM, breaklines, field survey, or datum reconciliation.

fema_nfhl_centroid_intersection.interpretation: The parcel-layer centroid intersects an NFHL polygon mapped Zone AE and marked SFHA. The service returned -9999 for STATIC_BFE and no vertical datum, so no usable base flood elevation is established by this query.
fema_nfhl_centroid_intersection.limitation: Point intersection only; does not determine the percentage of the parcel in each zone, flood depth, flood probability at the structure, or a site-specific hydraulic result. Verify effective FEMA map products in the FEMA Map Service Center.

indiana_dnr_flood_hazard_crosscheck.source_agency: Indiana Department of Natural Resources / Indiana Geographic Information Office
indiana_dnr_flood_hazard_crosscheck.interpretation: The queried Indiana DNR-hosted feature explicitly reports source_dnr=NFHL and the same DFIRM/flood-area identifiers as the FEMA query. This is a same-source republishing/consistency check, not independent flood evidence. -9999 values are no-data sentinels, not measurements.

watershed_delineation.candidate_method: USGS StreamStats delineation checked against USGS 3DEP elevation and current 3D Hydrography Program / legacy NHD-WBD context as available
required_checks: Select and document the hydraulic outlet / point of interest before delineating the contributing catchment.
Review the basin boundary and drainage paths against high-resolution terrain and hydrography; USGS cautions that DEM-derived delineations can contain errors, especially in flat terrain.
Record catchment area, outlet, terrain acquisition/version, horizontal CRS, vertical datum, processing steps, and SHA-256 for every model input.

blockers: Hydrologic catchment and outlet have not been delineated and independently checked.
No approved AOI approval evidence/reviewer/timestamp is recorded.
Site-specific HEC-HMS and HEC-RAS model packages and inventories have not been supplied and reviewed.
Installed solver versions and immutable, version-tested HMS, DSS-transfer, and RAS adapter commands have not been verified.
Design-storm/observed rainfall selection, basin parameters, hydrograph and boundary-condition mappings are not established.
A suitable terrain/geometry package, CRS/vertical-datum reconciliation, calibration, independent validation, uncertainty review, and qualified engineering disposition remain required.
coupled_model_readiness.results_interpretation: No flood simulation, design flow, flood depth, water-surface elevation, or engineering recommendation is claimed by this evidence record.

source_conflicts.summary: A previously supplied planning extent associated with this site does not contain the independently returned 2025 Indiana GIO parcel centroid; the centroid is about 5.1 km south of that extent. The older extent's provenance and intended geometry role have not been independently established.
source_conflicts.action: Do not merge the extents, use the older envelope as the property boundary, or use either parcel geometry as the HEC-HMS drainage catchment. Retain the source conflict for human reconciliation before an AOI approval.

raster_crosscheck.source_raster_nominal_resolution: 1/3 arc-second source DEM; approximately 10 m ground resolution, latitude-dependent
raster_crosscheck.metadata_note: The GeoTIFF itself does not embed units or vertical datum tags; CRS, units, vertical datum, and source lineage are documented in the dataset README and companion provenance sidecar. Add the sidecar before using this raster as a model input.
raster_crosscheck.interpretation: The sample values agree numerically at one coordinate, but this does not establish survey accuracy, a continuous terrain surface at the parcel scale, bare-earth validity, vertical datum realization, or suitability for hydraulic geometry.

hydrologic_unit_context.limitation: HUC polygons are regional hydrographic-unit boundaries. Inclusion of the parcel centroid in a HUC12 does not delineate the topographic contributing basin to a chosen hydraulic outlet and is not an HEC-HMS basin model.

parcel_floodplain_overlay.area_method: Planar overlay in UTM Zone 16N (EPSG:26916) using the current IGIO parcel polygon and the cached, coordinate-rounded four-county SFHA polygon layer.
parcel_floodplain_overlay.limitation: A cached GIS polygon overlay and centroid query are reference observations only. This layer's matching polygon declares source_dnr=NFHL; it is not independent confirmation, a survey, a parcel-specific regulatory determination, or an approved hydraulic result. The -9999 sentinels in live services are no-data, not elevations.

water_source_inventory.name: Wabash River at New Harmony, Indiana
water_source_inventory.availability_note: Official monitoring-location page reports continuous gage-height data over 2010-10-01 through 2026-10-15 at the time checked; available parameter/time coverage must be rechecked when acquiring a run's observations.
water_source_inventory.altitude_note: The published 352.71 ft NAVD88 site/gage altitude is not a published gage-zero-to-water-surface conversion and is not a site ground or BFE value.
water_source_inventory.intended_use: Regional Wabash River context and potential downstream-boundary evidence after review.
limitations: Approximately 32 km from the candidate parcel and drains a much larger regional basin.
Do not use raw gage height as NAVD88 water-surface elevation.
No gage-to-site transfer without a validated hydraulic profile.
Provisional data must retain its provisional qualifier and UTC/local time semantics.

water_source_inventory.name: Hovey Lake near Mount Vernon, Indiana
water_source_inventory.availability_note: The official location page reports a historic daily-data period ending 1968-09-29 at the time checked; the nearby point is not evidence of current continuous streamflow observations.
water_source_inventory.intended_use: Hydrography/site context only unless a later parameter-specific data query proves a fit-for-purpose record.
limitations: Lake/reservoir/impoundment station, not a substitute for a current stream gage at the selected outlet.
Historical record must not be treated as current or as a calibration set without relevance review.

water_source_inventory.name: National Weather Service forecast grid for the candidate parcel centroid
water_source_inventory.intended_use: Forecast and operational context with source forecast valid times retained separately from observations.
limitations: Point metadata does not supply observed rainfall totals or a design storm.
Select and validate a specific precipitation/QPE product before using it as HEC-HMS forcing.
Radar reflectivity in dBZ is not a rainfall accumulation.
